author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Crimson Desert has some of the strangest game features I have ever seen including in this case the ability to just tackle and capture enemies and then get revenge for the havoc they have brought to your gold investments that you store at the local bank. Yeah this is not exactly a guide but rather how to send a message to the enemy.
